## How to Perform Keyword Gap Analysis with _SEO Missions?_

Step 1

### List your _competitors_

Get all the data on top-ranking SERPs, keywords, and questions in one place. No more dozens of open tabs.

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/step-1-SM.png)

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/step-2.png)

Step 2

### SEOwind analyzes the _data_

Use SEOwind to gather detailed keyword data from each competitor. Our keyword gap analysis provides insights on:

- Search Volume
- Match – number of the competitors ranking for this keyword
- Keyword Difficulty
- Cost Per Click
- Search Intent
- Priority

Step 3

### Select _keywords_

- Analyze the data to find high-value, low-competition keywords.
- Choose keywords that can drive traffic and conversions.
- Prioritize keywords that align with your content strategy.

## You’ve got questions. We’ve got answers.

### [Are the keywords still relevant?](https://seowind.io/explore-topics/\#)

Absolutely. Keywords reveal how users search for information and the phrases they use. Leveraging these insights helps your content resonate better with your audience.

### [How often should I perform Keyword Gap Analysis?](https://seowind.io/explore-topics/\#)

Perform Keyword Gap Analysis at least once a quarter. This keeps you updated with changes in competitor strategies and search engine algorithms, ensuring continuous SEO improvement.

### [Which subscription plans include SEO Missions?](https://seowind.io/explore-topics/\#)

SEO Missions are available in Pro and Agency plans.

### [How do I prioritize keywords from the analysis?](https://seowind.io/explore-topics/\#)

Focus on keywords with high search volume and low competition first. These are easier to rank for and can drive substantial traffic. Additionally, prioritize keywords that align with your business goals and user intent for maximum impact.

### [How do I integrate new keywords into my content strategy?](https://seowind.io/explore-topics/\#)

Incorporate new keywords into your existing content where relevant. Create new content targeting these keywords to boost your visibility further. Continuously optimize your content to match search intent and enhance user engagement.

### [Can SEO Missions work for small businesses?](https://seowind.io/explore-topics/\#)

Absolutely. SEO Missions are particularly beneficial for small businesses, enabling them to compete effectively by targeting high-value, low-competition keywords and improving their search visibility.
